name: executive-assistant
description: Highly configurable executive assistant for productivity workflow automation. Uses Google Workspace MCP for Gmail and Calendar. Supports Slack, Jira, Linear, and multiple note-taking tools (Obsidian, Notion, Logseq, Roam, Markdown).

notes_vault_path.title: Notes vault path
notes_vault_path.description: Root folder of your notes vault (Obsidian, Logseq, or plain markdown). Leave empty if you use Notion or Roam.

notes_provider.title: Notes provider
notes_provider.description: Which notes tool to use: obsidian, notion, logseq, roam, or markdown.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for calendar and daily-note dates, e.g. America/Toronto.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for the Google Workspace MCP server (Gmail + Calendar).

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for the Google Workspace MCP server.
